The benthic worm is a deep-blue creature that is more at home in flooded tunnels than dry caves. While a benthic worm is a strong swimmer, it prefers to lie in wait within the walls, floor, or even ceiling of flooded caverns, ready to spring out and ambush creatures swimming past its hiding spot. The benthic worm is particularly hated and feared by Darklands-dwelling cultures, due to the fact that a benthic worm that burrows into a tunnel often brings with it waters from the submerged river or lake it calls home. When it becomes obvious that a benthic worm is near a Darklands settlement, the inhabitants quickly establish a hunting party to deal with the menace before it can bring ruin. **[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 34 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 32 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 29 [Benthic Worm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2872) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 56 **Perception** +22; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=82) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 100 feet **Languages** **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +33, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +20 **Str** +10 **Dex** -1 **Con** +8 **Int** -5 **Wis** -1 **Cha** -1 --- **AC** 35 **Fort** +32 **Ref** +20 **Will** +23 **HP** 320 **Inexorable** The cave worm recovers from the [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92), and [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93) conditions at the end of its turn. It's also immune to penalties to its Speeds and the [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) condition, and it ignores [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) and greater difficult terrain.
**Slough Skin** **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** The cave worm would be affected by a condition or adverse effect (such as [_cursed metamorphosis_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1479)); **Effect** The cave worm negates the triggering condition or effect by sloughing an outer layer of its skin. Effects from [artifacts](/Traits.aspx?ID=537), deities, or a similarly powerful source can't be avoided in this way. --- **Speed** 40 feet, burrow 40 feet, swim 60 feet **Melee** jaws +31 ([deadly 2d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d12+16 piercing plus [Improved Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=66) **Melee** stinger +31 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 4d6+16 piercing plus benthic worm venom **Melee** body +29 ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 2d8+14 bludgeoning **Benthic Worm Venom** ([Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) **Saving Throw** DC 37 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 3d6 poison damage and [clumsy 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) (1 round); **Stage 2** 4d6 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 6d6 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round) **Breach** The benthic worm Swims up to its swim Speed, then [Leaps](/Actions.aspx?ID=2298) vertically out of the water up to 30 feet, making a Strike against a creature at the apex of the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 45 feet of the water's surface). After the Strike, the worm splashes back down. It can use [Improved Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=66) on this Strike and follow it up with Fast Swallow. **Fast Swallow** **Trigger** The worm Grabs a creature; **Effect** The worm uses Swallow Whole. **[Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77)** ([Attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15)) Huge, 3d8+10 bludgeoning, Rupture 27 **Thrash** The worm attempts one Strike against each creature in its reach. It can Strike up to once with its jaws, up to once with its stinger, and any number of times with its body. Each attack counts toward the worm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.
